summary: Parked-up residential kerb on Jesmond Road; houses 12-13 m away on this side.
reasons: Heavy tree cover shades the kerb

best_section.where: West kerb just south of the roundabout, before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-13 m from the kerb on the west side, with more across the road at 17-21 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane where other cars are parked; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road beside a roundabout, with a school bus zone nearby.
drivers.convention: 1P parallel signs and cars parked along it, so overnight parking is not the norm.

flags: 1P Parallel signs nearby; check time limit on site
Bus Zone school days 7-9am near the stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the north half, shading from the east and west; open to the south.
